jsonld_raw.name: (130 G) VETIVER MANGO SCENTED CANDLE
jsonld_raw.description:
Scented candle made of vegetable wax.

Vetiver Mango | Tropical and green, like a breath of sun-ripened fruit.

NOTES
Top notes: mango, apple.
Heart notes: Java vetiver.
Base notes: milk accord, vanilla.

The candle comes in a cylindrical jar with a lid and a striped cover with a drawstring closure.
